cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.
